chapter: Team Magma Space Center invasion (control room, infiltrators)
cap_confirmation: driver state reported level_cap 84; all four members at offset 1 = L83 = cap + offset - 2 on Medium.
chronology_note: Same raid party and audit as E0401: Mind Badge earned, before the Seafloor Cavern; no pool-84 addition used. Landorus is the one reachable legend.
pre_play_strategy_checks: Zoroark enters disguised as Shiftry (last party member) and the illusion covers Kingambit's Swords Dance
Kingambit Supreme Overlord grows with fallen allies; Kowtow Cleave / Sucker Punch
Cacturne Water Absorb / Sucker Punch second priority lane
Shiftry Wind Rider, Fake Out, Focus Sash

attempts.party: party_raid84.json (Incineroar / Urshifu-Rapid / Mega Swampert / Great Tusk / Landorus / Gholdengo)
attempts.why: Kingambit led beside the disguised Zoroark ('Shiftry' in every message; the driver's state exposes SPECIES_ZOROARK but I played the messages). Turn 1 the disguise Protected, Fake Out went into Kingambit and Close Combat (4x) one-shot it before Swords Dance - the general died first, the opposite of the plan. Turn 2 Dark Pulse flinched Urshifu (-1 Def from Close Combat) and Cacturne's Seed Bomb killed it from full through the Sash - the one faint; Flare Blitz broke the illusion and left Zoroark at 1 on its Sash. Turn 3 Landorus in, Sludge Bomb killed Cacturne, Knock Off killed Zoroark. Turn 4 Shiftry Fake Out flinched Landorus, Flare Blitz left it at 1 on its Sash. Turn 5 Sludge Bomb finished it.

strategy_checks.evidence: turn 1-2 messages name 'the opposing Shiftry' for the Zoroark slot; turn 2 'The opposing Zoroark's illusion wore off!' after Flare Blitz
Kingambit chose Swords Dance turn 1 but was flinched and killed by a 4x Close Combat; the disguise used that turn on Protect rather than attacking
Kingambit was in the lead slot with zero fallen allies, so Supreme Overlord contributed nothing; the plan says it is 'deliberately placed to come in late' but the authored party order puts it first
Seed Bomb knockout on Urshifu turn 2; Sucker Punch and Water Absorb never relevant (I never used a Water move into it)
turn 4 Fake Out flinched Landorus, Sash held Flare Blitz

protect_ledger.payoff: empty - nothing targeted it; and the plan's whole point for the disguise turn was to draw an attack away from Kingambit's Swords Dance, which Protect cannot do

protect_summary: 1 Protect, empty and strategically backwards (the disguised piece should be the one attacking or standing still to absorb fire, not guarding).

ai_defects.board: Kingambit 337/337 (-1 Atk) and disguised Zoroark 219/219 Sash versus Incineroar and Urshifu-Rapid
ai_defects.better: Kingambit facing a Fighting type with 4x Close Combat should attack or be the one Protecting; Zoroark as the decoy should attack (Nasty Plot / Flamethrower) so the disguise absorbs targeting. Protect on the decoy plus Swords Dance on the 4x-weak general is the pair's plan inverted.

ai_notes: Turn 2 Dark Pulse into the -1 Def Urshifu and Seed Bomb 2x on it was the right focus fire and it won a knockout. Cacturne correctly never used Sucker Punch into Landorus' Protect-free turn.

level_changes.why: won attempt 1 with one faint; the decoy's contribution was one flinch
entered last, one Fake Out, died in two hits

level_change_rationale: Brief step 5: first-try 4-1. Kingambit is the room's general and Cacturne scored the faint; the two Focus Sash pieces go +1.
cooler: The infiltration concept is excellent and the illusion genuinely reads in play (the messages say Shiftry until it breaks). It fails structurally, not on levels: Kingambit is authored in slot 1 so Supreme Overlord starts at zero and it eats the Fighting move meant for the whole room. Cooler and correct to the plan: reorder the party so Kingambit is the last slot (Zoroark then also disguises as Kingambit, a much better bluff than Shiftry) and Shiftry leads with Fake Out. That is a party-order change, not a set change; flagged for the main agent.
legality_notes: Sets legal. Party order contradicts the plan text ('deliberately placed to come in late'); Illusion copies the last slot, which is Shiftry, so the bluff is a 60/40/40 body pretending to be another Focus Sash attacker.
verification_limit: The +1 on Zoroark and Shiftry cannot be re-verified until the main agent rebuilds.
